8.3.9.5 E2E_P08CheckInit
[SWS_E2E_91040] Definition of API function E2E_P08CheckInit
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08527, RS_E2E_08539
⌈
Service Name
E2E_P08CheckInit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P08CheckInit (
E2E_P08CheckStateType* StatePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x5b
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
None
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
StatePtr
Pointer to port/data communication state.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E2E_E_INPUTERR_NULL - null pointer passed E2E_E_OK
Description
Initializes the check state
Available via
E2E.h
⌋
[SWS_E2E_10005]
Upstream requirements: RS_E2E_08528, RS_E2E_08539
⌈In case State is NULL, E2E_P08CheckInit shall return immediately with E2E_E_IN-
PUTERR_NULL. Otherwise, it shall initialize the state structure, setting:
1. Counter to 0xFF’FF’FF’FF
Protection Library
2. Status to E2E_P08STATUS_ERROR.
⌋
